short_description: Keep three daily routines on your desk with custom steps, undo and automatic progress recovery.
description: Keep three daily routines on your desk with custom steps, undo and automatic progress recovery. Choose Morning, Focus or Shutdown with the wheel. Click to finish a step, or tap Start to undo. In app settings, enter up to seven short ASCII steps per route separated by |. Each routine keeps its own progress for the day. Changing a routine starts its new list at the first step.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
